description: Evidence-bound analysis of a supplied capture: content detection, packet/flow extraction, standard-protocol observations, traffic statistics, conservative access-behavior candidates, and conditional access-behavior type classification.
limitations: Standard protocol recognition is performed only when the capture and dissector expose evidence.
Traffic behavior candidates are not application semantics, user identities, or maliciousness labels.
Access-behavior type candidates come from a frozen classifier trained on external labelled flows; a score below the rejection threshold is reported as unknown rather than forced into a class.
Encrypted payload plaintext is never claimed without explicit decryption material.
